  "sql": "WITH _base AS (\n  SELECT\n    customers__regions.name AS \"orders.customers.regions.name\",\n    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS \"orders.order_date\",\n    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS \"orders.revenue\"\n  FROM orders AS orders\n  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers\n    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id\n  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions\n    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id\n  WHERE\n    (\n      orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)\n      AND orders.order_date < CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE)\n    )\n  GROUP BY\n    customers__regions.name,\n    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)\n), _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by_order_date AS (\n  SELECT\n    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS \"orders.order_date\",\n    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS \"orders.amount_sum_partition_by_order_date\"\n  FROM orders AS orders\n  WHERE\n    (\n      orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)\n      AND orders.order_date < CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE)\n    )\n  GROUP BY\n    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)\n), base AS (\n  SELECT\n    _base.\"orders.customers.regions.name\",\n    _base.\"orders.order_date\",\n    _base.\"orders.revenue\",\n    _base.\"orders.revenue\" / NULLIF(\n      _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by_order_date.\"orders.amount_sum_partition_by_order_date\",\n      0\n    ) AS \"orders.share\",\n    _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by_order_date.\"orders.amount_sum_partition_by_order_date\" AS \"orders.amount_sum_partition_by_order_date\"\n  FROM _base\n  LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by_order_date\n    ON _base.\"orders.order_date\" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by_order_date.\"orders.order_date\"\n), shifted__time_shift_inner AS (\n  SELECT\n    customers__regions.name AS \"orders.customers.regions.name\",\n    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS \"orders.order_date\",\n    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS \"orders.revenue\"\n  FROM orders AS orders\n  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers\n    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id\n  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions\n    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id\n  GROUP BY\n    customers__regions.name,\n    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)\n), sjoin__time_shift_inner AS (\n  SELECT\n    base.\"orders.customers.regions.name\",\n    base.\"orders.order_date\",\n    base.\"orders.revenue\",\n    base.\"orders.share\",\n    base.\"orders.amount_sum_partition_by_order_date\",\n    shifted__time_shift_inner.\"orders.revenue\" AS \"orders._time_shift_inner\"\n  FROM base\n  LEFT JOIN shifted__time_shift_inner\n    ON base.\"orders.customers.regions.name\" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM shifted__time_shift_inner.\"orders.customers.regions.name\"\n    AND base.\"orders.order_date\" - INTERVAL 1 MONTH IS NOT DISTINCT FROM shifted__time_shift_inner.\"orders.order_date\"\n), step1 AS (\n  SELECT\n    \"orders.customers.regions.name\",\n    \"orders.order_date\",\n    \"orders.revenue\",\n    \"orders.share\",\n    \"orders.amount_sum_partition_by_order_date\",\n    \"orders._time_shift_inner\",\n    \"orders.revenue\" - \"orders._time_shift_inner\" AS \"orders.change\"\n  FROM sjoin__time_shift_inner\n)\nSELECT\n  \"orders.customers.regions.name\",\n  \"orders.order_date\",\n  \"orders.revenue\",\n  \"orders.share\",\n  \"orders.change\"\nFROM (\n  SELECT\n    \"orders.customers.regions.name\",\n    \"orders.order_date\",\n    \"orders.revenue\",\n    \"orders.share\",\n    \"orders.amount_sum_partition_by_order_date\",\n    \"orders._time_shift_inner\",\n    \"orders.change\"\n  FROM step1\n) AS _outer\nORDER BY\n  \"orders.order_date\" ASC,\n  \"orders.customers.regions.name\" ASC\nLIMIT 101"
}

args.message: Q1 2025 revenue by month and region, each region's share of that month's revenue, and the change from the previous month. January's change is measured against December 2024. No Q1 orders came from customers with an unknown region, so there is no null-region group.
